Description:
As a member service agent, I want to update a member's mailing address from the member profile page, so that statements go to the right place.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Agent opens the member profile and edits the address fields
- New address is saved on the member record
- A success message is shown

Summary: [GAP-TEST] Validate address with USPS before save
Description:
As a member service agent, I want the entered address to be checked against USPS, so that we store deliverable addresses.

Acceptance Criteria:
- On save, the address is sent to the USPS validation service
- If USPS returns a standardized address, the agent can accept it
- The accepted address is stored on the member record
